items.q: there was a war, a civil war like - created by Maximo Gomez, in Santiago de Cuba

ctx.x: Was it popular then? When you were growing up?

We don't know about it; there was a war, a civil war like - created by Maximo Gomez, in Santiago de Cuba, that became black fighting against white. Evaristo Tenor and few veterans from the liberation army and he create that in order - - -
